According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman's report, Apple is preparing for the release of its Home product line and will make significant changes in its physical retail stores. Apple is expected to announce updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this autumn, and the related changes seem to hint that a third, more important product will debut at the same time.

Apple has accumulated a large number of unreleased Home products, mainly because the Siri revamp project has been delayed again and again. Now that the redesign of Siri is finally complete, we can expect that some of these products will finally meet everyone after years without updates.

However, earlier reports had pointed out that Apple would first launch updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (i.e., a HomePod or HomePad with a built-in screen) might only arrive later.

However, based on the current preparations at retail stores, this smart home hub may be launched together with the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. The above is from the Power On newsletter.

Of course, the final answer will have to wait for Apple's September launch event. However, according to today's report, Apple's brand-new smart home hub is very likely to debut alongside the updated Apple TV 4K and the HomePod mini that supports Siri AI.

Key takeaways

In summary, Apple's smart home hub is widely rumoured to come with a 7-inch square display and will be available in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with magnets on the back for wall mounting. This product will run a brand-new operating system, with the home screen supporting widgets. In addition to supporting FaceTime video calls, it will also serve as the central hub for all smart home accessories and Siri, and will feature a built-in A18 chip.

Another rumour about the Home product line is that the next-generation Apple TV 4K may come with an updated Siri Remote, though the specific changes remain unclear for now.

Are you interested in the new Home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
